artworks.title: Virgin and Child in the Clouds
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a woman and a child, both partially surrounded by clouds. The woman faces slightly to the left, looking down at the child she holds in her arms. She has a serene expression with soft eyes and full lips, and her long, wavy hair falls over her shoulders. She wears a large, ornate crown with visible stars. The child, with curly hair, leans against the woman's chest. Both are dressed in flowing garments. To the left is a shield with symbols and a decorative frame. The background features detailed cloud patterns.

artworks.title: The Risen Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a man standing in a relaxed contrapposto position. The man has facial features including a beard and wavy hair. He is shirtless with a draped cloth covering his lower body. He holds a staff in his left hand and raises his fingers on his right hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Nude Woman Holding a Mirror (Allegory of Vanitas)
Bookplate of Hieronymus Baumgartner
artworks.description: In the image is an ornate coat of arms with a bird perched on top and flanked by intricate foliage patterns. The color palette includes shades of black, white, and gray. An hourglass is in the upper left corner and a round clock face in the upper right corner. A skull is at the bottom left of the coat of arms. The main elements are enclosed within a square frame, with inscriptions along the sides and bottom.

artworks.title: Standard Bearer, Drummer, and Piper
artworks.description: There are three men standing side by side in the image. The man on the left carries a spear and wears a jacket with puffed sleeves, short trousers with a feather decoration, and shoes. His hat has a long, twisted feather. The central figure, seen from the back, wears a similarly elaborate outfit with large puffed sleeves, tight stockings, and a feathered hat. He holds a sword with a detailed hilt. The man on the right faces the central figure, holding drumsticks. He wears a doublet with puffed sleeves, stylish pants, and shoes. His head is bald on top with hair on the sides, and he has a mustache. In the background are sparse vegetation and small stones on the ground. The image features the text '1543' and the initials 'IsB' at the top right.

artworks.title: The Annunciation to the Virgin
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring numerous figures in various positions and interactions. One central figure is depicted with flowing garments and a halo-like radiance around their head. The other individuals are shown in different poses and expressions, with curly or wavy hair and wearing classical draped robes. Some figures appear to be supporting each other, and in the background, there are clusters of people and mythical beings on raised ground, with architectural and landscape elements adding detail to the scene.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.medium: relief etching//plate inked by transferring ink from another plate thinly coated with ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a section of text with decorative elements. The image showcases an extract of text in an old-fashioned script. The text appears to be incised, with the incised areas highlighted to stand out against the background. In addition to the text, there is a small, abstract decoration in the upper right corner. The style suggests a historical or classical theme, often found in illuminated manuscripts or old documents.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.medium: relief etching//effect of inking with an ordinary gelatin roller
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract arrangement of curving lines and shapes in the upper part. These lines frame a piece of text in a stylized script above an abstract human figure lying down. A shape resembling a bird in flight is also present, adding to the dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of text with a small illustration. The illustration includes handwritten text containing a poetic verse and a small drawing of a human figure at the bottom left corner. The text describes figures or entities that have risen and references specific names like "Franklin" and "Green." The handwritten style is reminiscent of historical documents or poems. The drawing of a reclining human figure contributes to the classical appearance associated with historical manuscripts or literary works.

artworks.title: Head of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: etching//restrike impression from verso of Blake'scancelled plate for "A Prophecy" (1943.3.1848.b)
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed etching of a man's head and shoulders. The man appears to be facing downward with a serious expression. He has deep-set eyes, furrowed brows, a prominent nose, a full wavy beard, and long hair. The man is holding a cross in the lower left corner. The background is plain, highlighting the intricate line work of the man's face and hair.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.medium: relief etching//plate inked from a very stiff piece of card with ink rolled on to that in graduated color
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines creating a textured background transitioning from green to purple. It has an abstract quality. The script-like text overlays the gradient background. The colors and cursive text form shapes similar to a wave or hill, with scattered dark speckles on top.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.medium: relief etching//plate inked with black from card
artworks.description: This is a drawing of text and an abstract form. The image features handwritten text in a script style alongside abstract forms created with scattered ink dots and lines. The text reads, "who rose in silent night, Gates Franklin. & Green;" and "From Albans they Bruce," among other lines that are partially cut off. The abstract forms include clusters of dots resembling clouds and a small stylized tree or plant depicted in the top right corner. Below the text, additional abstract graphics, possibly a reclining figure or shape, contribute to the visual interest. The overall composition suggests attention to both textual and abstract design elements.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.medium: relief etching//pulled on colored background, madeby rolling up the other side of the plate with inks and running it through the press
artworks.description: The image showcases curved and meandering lines forming an abstract textural background. In the upper area, there is a transition from bright green to teal, resembling swirling patterns. A delicate line drawing of a bird in flight is present in the upper right. Below, calligraphic text including names such as "Gates," "Franklin," and "Greene" is visible. The lower portion shifts into shades of pink and purple, creating a dreamlike landscape akin to a colorful sunset horizon.

artworks.title: Graveurs en taille douce au burin et à l'eau forte (Copper Plate Engravers and Etchers)
artworks.description: This is an image of an engraving studio with two artists at work. The studio is well-lit and shows one artist on the left working on a sketch at a drafting table, surrounded by tools and papers, and another artist on the right focused on a copper plate. The studio features framed portraits and landscapes on a far wall, with a cloak and hat hung in the center. The scene is depicted in detailed line work.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Apostles
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.5 × 5.4 cm (2 15/16 × 2 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with classical architecture. Several individuals are gathered around a central figure who appears to be washing something, with radiant lines emanating from this figure. The composition is set against a backdrop of ruins with classical columns and buildings with multiple stories. The figures are adorned in robes, and there is an abundance of architectural detail, including arches and pillars. The sky above features clouds.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.5 × 5.5 cm (2 15/16 × 2 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a gathering around a long table. The scene is enclosed within an archway featuring ornate architectural detailing, including a decorative crest at the top center. Inside the arch, there is a central figure radiating light, seated at the midpoint, surrounded by other seated figures engaged in various dining activities. The figures are detailed with intricate linework giving texture to their garments and expressions. The composition of the drawing creates symmetry and balance, with the central archway framing the scene. The style of the drawing suggests a detailed and precise technique, highlighting both the figures and architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8 × 6.5 cm (3 1/8 × 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with figures witnessing a divine apparition. The image features a figure in the sky surrounded by radiant light and clouds, holding a chalice. Below, several figures are depicted with reverent gestures as they kneel or lay on the ground. To the right, there is an enclosure with a structure surrounded by a fence. The lines are sharply defined, and cross-hatching gives depth and texture to the scene. Trees appear along the sides with their branches swept by the wind, adding a dynamic element to the composition.

artworks.title: The Betrayal
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 × 6.5 cm (3 5/16 × 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a black and white ink drawing showing several figures in a dynamic and chaotic scene. The background features architectural elements and trees. The figures seem to be engaged in some kind of interaction, with banners and spears adding movement to the composition. Wind-swept trees are depicted on the right side. The use of lines creates texture and depth, evoking a sense of action and tumult often seen in Baroque period art.

artworks.title: Christ Condemned to Death by Pilate
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 × 6.8 cm (3 5/16 × 2 11/16 in.)

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.3 × 6.6 cm (3 1/4 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: There are figures inside a circular structure. The scene shows several figures engaged in an activity under a large cylindrical or conical structure. Various tools or weapons are present, and the figures seem to be interacting physically. The structure has an arched entrance with wooden frameworks and a rope hanging from the top. Light and shadow emphasize the forms and enhance the dramatic intensity, while the line work adds texture and movement to the composition.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 × 6.4 cm (3 5/16 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with architectural elements and figures in elaborate attire. The scene depicts a bustling street with several figures interacting in front of grand buildings with classical architectural details. One of the structures has a turret-like feature, and there is a flag or banner that reads "SPQR." The figures are engaged in various activities, some carrying spears and others conferring. The drawing is in the style of Jacques Callot, known for detailed line work in etchings.

artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 6.6 cm (3 3/8 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with an archway. The image features a detailed rendering of a large, arched gateway that frames a deeper view of a courtyard or interior space. The structure is made more prominent by its intricate crosshatching technique, which creates depth and shadow. The foreground shows an arched entrance constructed of stones with a circular emblem at its apex. The arch opens into a scene of activity featuring several figures engaged in a variety of dynamic actions. These figures are gathered in small groups or interacting among themselves, adding a sense of narrative and liveliness to the composition. The vaulted ceiling and stone masonry are drawn with precision, contributing to the historical atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 6.5 cm (3 3/8 × 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand archway with a crowd of people gathered beneath it. The architectural structure depicted is an imposing two-story stone archway flanked by two identical rectangular towers with slanted roofs. Atop the arch, a group of carved figures in dramatic poses is positioned. The crowd below is dressed in flowing garments typical of classical or historical settings, with some figures raising their arms or wielding sticks. The linear, fine lines and attention to architectural detail suggest a meticulous rendering style typical of classical etchings.
